task_objective: Enforce the placeholder-pattern named-group invariant and refresh stale verdict audit context hashes without disturbing verdict timestamps or unchanged-store determinism.

setup.remote_dev_pull: Attempted git pull --ff-only origin dev and captured the failure at /tmp/decky-plugins-extended-audit-invariants-setup.log; origin has no dev ref, so the clean local dev tip c6d415c was used as the required base.
setup.plan_history: The plan was already committed at the dev tip as c6d415c, so feat/audit-invariants inherited the required plan-first commit instead of creating a duplicate empty commit.
setup.tooling: The repository has no run.sh. XDG_CACHE_HOME was isolated under /tmp because the sandboxed global uv cache was read-only.

implementation.placeholder_invariant: A biconditional test now requires every secret pattern with a named value group to be placeholder-enabled and every placeholder-enabled pattern to define that group.
implementation.context_refresh: When classification, blocking rule IDs, and artifact hash are unchanged but audit_context_hash differs, _record_verdict updates only audit_context_hash and writes the store.
implementation.determinism: When all stable fields and audit_context_hash are unchanged, _record_verdict performs no write and preserves byte-identical output. Context-only refreshes preserve the existing audited_at; changed verdicts still replace the record and timestamp.

verification_evidence.tdd_red: Before the production fix, the focused suite reported 1 failed and 12 passed; the context-only record retained audit_context_hash=context instead of new-context.
verification_evidence.invariant_extra_member_failure: Temporarily adding github_token to _PLACEHOLDER_SECRET_PATTERNS made the biconditional test fail 1 test with AssertionError: github_token.
verification_evidence.scanner_crash_reproduction: With github_token temporarily placeholder-enabled, scanning a matching ghp_ token exited 1 with IndexError: no such group.
verification_evidence.invariant_missing_group_failure: Temporarily removing generic_api_key's named value group made the biconditional test fail 1 test with AssertionError: generic_api_key, proving the opposite direction.
verification_evidence.verdict_controls: 3 passed: identical verdict and context performed no write and preserved bytes; context-only change updated exactly audit_context_hash and preserved audited_at; classification change updated audited_at.
verification_evidence.context_branch_mutation: Removing Task 2's context-refresh branch made the context-only test fail 1 test because the old hash remained.
verification_evidence.invariant_test_removal: Removing Task 1's test and selecting its keyword collected no tests: 5 deselected, pytest exit 5.
verification_evidence.protected_suites: 31 passed across catalog-gate, audit-verdicts, verdict-publication, and secret-rule-precision.
verification_evidence.quality_gates: Ruff check passed; 32 files already formatted; 234 passed and 21 subtests passed; no deleted review notes.

test_adjustment_rationale: The verdict-publication determinism test previously treated a changed context hash as fully unchanged. The plan explicitly changes that behavior, so it was split into unchanged-context, context-only, and changed-verdict cases without weakening any stable-field or timestamp guarantee.
not_verified: The placeholder crash requires a future edit that breaks the coupling; the invariant test prevents that edit but does not prove the current pattern set is otherwise correct.
No classification or catalog-output behavior depends on audit_context_hash today, so this plan did not re-audit plugins or compare catalog output.
